description: This file contains unit tests for the TailscaleIntegrationSection SwiftUI view, testing its behavior under various simulated service states.

classes.name: TailscaleIntegrationSectionTests
classes.description: Unit test suite for the TailscaleIntegrationSection view.

methods.name: `tailscale section builds body when not installed`
methods.description: Test that the view builds its body correctly when the Tailscale service is not installed.

methods.name: `tailscale section builds body for serve mode`
methods.description: Test that the view builds its body correctly when Tailscale service is installed and in 'serve' mode.

methods.name: `tailscale section builds body for funnel mode`
methods.description: Test that the view builds its body correctly when Tailscale service is installed but not running, in 'funnel' mode.
